title: Rune Technologies Joins Lockheed Martin Team for Army's Next Generation Command and Control Initiative | Rune Technologies News
summary: Rune Technologies collaborates with Lockheed Martin on Army NGC2 initiative.
body_markdown:
# Partnership with Lockheed Martin


Rune Technologies has entered into a strategic partnership with Lockheed Martin to support the Army's Next Generation Command and Control (NGC2) initiative. This collaboration focuses on integrating advanced technologies to improve operational effectiveness and enhance mission success.


> "Together, we are committed to delivering innovative solutions that meet the evolving needs of the Army," said a spokesperson from Rune Technologies.


This partnership is expected to yield significant advancements in military logistics and command capabilities.
